mapper.select: SELECT a.cinema_id, c.cinema_name, a.admin_password FROM admins a JOIN cinemas c ON c.cinema_id = a.cinema_id WHERE a.admin_code = #{code}
SELECT room_id, room_name, floor, is_active AS active FROM rooms WHERE cinema_id = #{cinemaId} ORDER BY floor, room_id
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE bookings IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT b.booking_id, u.user_id, u.login_id, u.phone_number, s.screening_id FROM bookings b JOIN screenings s ON s.screening_id = b.screening_id JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = b.user_id WHERE r.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND r.room_id = #{roomId} AND b.booking_status = 'DONE' ORDER BY u.login_id, s.screening_id, b.booking_id

SELECT bs.booking_id, bs.booked_seat_id, bs.screening_id, st.row_name, st.col_num FROM booked_seats bs JOIN seats st ON st.seat_id = bs.seat_id WHERE
bs.booking_id IN
#{id}
FALSE
ORDER BY bs.booking_id, st.row_name, st.col_num
